question: How many days of paid time off for rest does Sourcegraph encourage me to take each year?
key_facts: Teammates are encouraged to take a minimum of 30 days of paid time off for rest per calendar year.
must_not: PTO is capped at a fixed maximum number of days.

question: Is there a limit on how much PTO I can take?
key_facts: There is no set limit on the amount of PTO.
must_not: PTO is capped at a fixed maximum number of days.

question: Do I need my manager's approval before going on vacation, and how much notice should I give?
key_facts: No formal PTO approval is needed for short-term time off.
You should inform your manager at least 5 business days before the leave (where practicable).
must_not: You must get your manager's approval before taking vacation.

question: Where do I record my PTO?
key_facts: PTO is recorded in PTO by Deel (the Deel plugin/app).

question: I'm paid through Remote.com. Do I need to do anything extra when I take PTO?
key_facts: You must also submit the PTO request in the Remote.com system.

question: Can I take a day off to bring my dog to the vet?
key_facts: Yes: taking a pet to the vet is a valid reason for paid time off.
must_not: Taking a pet to the vet is not a valid reason for paid time off.

question: Within how many days do I need to file an expense report?
key_facts: Expense reports must be filed within 60 days of the purchase.

question: What happens if I buy a physical item that costs more than $1,000?
key_facts: A physical item costing more than $1,000 becomes company property.

question: What is the budget for setting up my home desk?
key_facts: New teammates may spend up to $2,000 on desk setup.

question: How much is the monthly wellness stipend, and do I need to expense it?
key_facts: The wellness stipend is $100 per month.
It is added to pay automatically and does not need to be expensed.
must_not: The wellness stipend must be submitted as an expense report.

question: Will the company pay for my internet connection at home?
key_facts: Yes: $50 per month for an internet/WiFi plan.
It is added to pay automatically and does not need to be expensed.

question: How much does Sourcegraph reimburse for a co-working space?
key_facts: Co-working space is covered at $300-500 per month.

question: How often do engineers get a new laptop?
key_facts: Engineering (and Product) laptops are refreshed every 2.5 years.

question: How much does the company cover for laptop repairs?
key_facts: Laptop repairs are covered up to $500 per year.

question: What is the yearly budget for conferences and courses?
key_facts: The education and professional development budget is $1,000 USD per year.

question: Until what age can my children be covered by my health insurance?
key_facts: Unmarried dependent children are covered up until age 26.
Health benefits are for US-based full-time employees.

question: How much of the health insurance premium does Sourcegraph pay?
key_facts: Sourcegraph covers 100% of medical, dental and vision premiums for employees and dependents.
This applies to US-based full-time employees.

question: How long do new hires have to enroll in health insurance?
key_facts: New hires have 30 days from their start date to enroll.
If they do not enroll within 30 days, coverage is automatically waived.

question: Does Sourcegraph offer long-term disability insurance?
key_facts: No: Sourcegraph does not offer short-term or long-term disability insurance.

question: Am I covered by our health plan when I travel abroad on holiday?
key_facts: No: the health benefits do not cover personal international travel.
Teammates are advised to buy travel insurance for the trip and expense it.
must_not: The health plan covers personal travel abroad.

question: Does the company match my 401k contributions?
key_facts: No: Sourcegraph does not match 401k contributions at this time.

question: How many weeks of paid parental leave do I get?
key_facts: Eligible teammates get up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave.
Leave is paid at 100% of salary (base pay).
must_not: Paid parental leave is at least 16 weeks or can be longer than 16 weeks.

question: I only started last month. Can I already take parental leave?
key_facts: Yes: there is no minimum tenure or waiting period for parental leave.
must_not: A minimum length of employment is required for parental leave.

question: How far in advance should I tell my manager that I plan to take parental leave?
key_facts: No later than 1 month before the expected leave start date.

question: My partner and I both work at Sourcegraph. Can we both take parental leave?
key_facts: Yes: each parent is individually eligible for paid parental leave.
The leave can be taken at the same time or at different times.

question: What is the maximum value of a gift I can accept from a vendor?
key_facts: Gifts with a market value of around $50 USD or less are generally fine.
must_not: There is no limit on the value of gifts.

question: Can I give a customer a gift card?
key_facts: Broadly usable gift cards (such as Visa or Amazon) are not acceptable.
Coffee or tea gift cards under $50 USD are acceptable.

question: How can I report a code of conduct violation anonymously?
key_facts: Through Convercent, the 24/7 third-party helpline.

question: Can I trade a customer's stock based on something I learned at work?
key_facts: No: buying or selling securities based on inside information is not allowed (it can be illegal insider trading).
must_not: Trading on information learned at work is allowed.

question: If I have a baby, how long can I take off and how do I update my health insurance?
key_facts: Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave.
A birth is a qualifying life event; insurance changes are made through Rippling.
The child must be added to insurance within 30 days of the birth.
The insurance steps apply to US employees.
must_not: Paid parental leave is at least 16 weeks or can be longer than 16 weeks.
